title: Maintaining the P-Trap Water Seal
description: The fundamental function of a drain P-trap is maintaining a standing water seal inside its dip section, creating a physical barrier against hazardous sewer gases entering living spaces. In infrequently used fixtures—such as guest room sinks, basement floor drains, or seasonal plumbing—this crucial water barrier continuously evaporates over time. Once the liquid level drops below the trap dip, sewer gas and unpleasant odors pass freely into the room. A essential professional tip for dry-prone fixtures is periodically running fresh water to replenish the trap reservoir and preserve environmental air quality.
